verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal documents locations and zones for managing readers across sites, with an API variant of that page. It also documents reader registration by registration code, serial number or order number, and says readers must be registered to a location. The general Stripe MCP server gives agents tools to call the Stripe API. However, the quoted evidence never explicitly shows API endpoints for creating a location or registering a reader, and some reader management is described as Dashboard-based. missing for 10: explicit API documentation for creating locations, explicit API calls for registering readers to a location, evidence of an agent running the full provisioning flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new location end-to-end via API — creating the location and registering its readers

citations.quote: You can streamline the management of multiple readers across different physical sites by using locations and zones.
You can register readers using their serial number. This method doesn’t require someone to physically have the reader to register it
You must register your reader to a location to accept payments.
Terminal supports an API-based integration in addition to SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native.
The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API
